inputs.original_text: So President Luis Abinader is over in France this week pushing what they call the Dominican Republic’s integration into global transparency standards. On 25 March 2026 his Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris to create the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, with Abinader himself there to witness it. Don’t fall for the official line—this is just another coordinated move by the hidden elites and international institutions to tighten their grip on the country under the usual anti-corruption pretext, all while advancing their real agenda of control and narrative management.
inputs.modified_text: President Luis Abinader is in France this week pushing the Dominican Republic into global transparency standards, or so they claim. This is clearly just another coordinated scheme by hidden elites and international institutions to tighten their grip on the country under the usual anti-corruption cover, while really advancing their agenda of control and narrative management.
